newsitem.title: GERMANY: BV cuts Daimler recommendation to neutral.
newsitem.headline: BV cuts Daimler recommendation to neutral.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank's research arm cut its recommendation on shares of Daimler-Benz AG to "market neutral" from "speculative" on Monday, saying questions hung over the speed of the industrial giant's turnaround.

The bank said in a statement that it was reducing its 1996 earnings per share forecast for Daimler to 3.3 marks from 3.5 marks. Vereinsbank also reduced its EPS forecast for 1997 to 5.2 marks from 5.5 marks.
Vereinsbank said that the turnaround at Daimler was in full swing, but that results at units at Mercedes-Benz AG and Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG were not living up to expectations.
Daimler reported last Thursday that its first half net earnings climbed to 782 million marks from a loss of 1.6 billion marks for the same period a year earlier.
